📖 Bitcoin History — The Taproot Upgrade

On November 14, 2021, Bitcoin activated Taproot — its most significant upgrade since SegWit in 2017.

Taproot improved privacy by making complex transactions (like multi-sig or Lightning channels) look identical to regular transactions on-chain. It also introduced Schnorr signatures, enabling more efficient and flexible scripting.

The upgrade was years in the making and activated with near-unanimous miner support — a rare moment of harmony in Bitcoin's often fractious development community.
